module: "History" section of the Dynamic Decals tool. Displays the undo (Undo) and redo (Redo) stacks of the API's history object (api.getHistory()), lets you undo/redo up to a chosen entry, clear the history, and shows the content of an action in a tooltip (dump truncated to 20 lines of 100 characters).
notes: "Delete All History" only clears the stacks: the changes already made remain, and the action is irreversible.

registerEditorPreferences.desc: Registers the float preference `dynamicDecalsTool.history.sectionHeight` (default 256, from 64 to 1024).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets the API and registers the "History" section (order 1045).
